thread:
erin_support: FYI — forwarded a customer report, toolcall returns 400 when args include a Windows env var + trailing comma

erin_support: customer payload they sent:
```json
POST /v1/toolcall
{
  "tool": "filesystem.read",
  "tool_args": "{ \"path\": \"C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\projects\\test.txt\", }"
}
```

josh_eng: seeing parse error on our side: "Unexpected token } in JSON at position 93"

ryan_sre: did they paste from Windows cmd? percent signs expand in cmd, but this looks like a trailing comma + double-stringified JSON + unescaped backslashes all at once

erin_support: they provided the curl they ran on Windows:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"tool\":\"filesystem.read\",\"tool_args\":\"{ \\\"path\\\": \\\"C:\\\\Users\\\\%USERNAME%\\\\projects\\\\test.txt\\\", }\" }"
```

josh_eng: yep — double-encoding + trailing comma. Windows cmd stripping/transforming escapes causes the inner JSON to be malformed when our parser gets it.

infra-bot: [logs] parser.error: json_parse_error at request_id=req_8b3f; payload_length=324; error="Unexpected token }"

josh_eng: repro steps I used locally:
1) Run the customer curl on Windows cmd (above) -> 400 w/ parse error
2) POST a direct JSON body (not double-stringified) -> 200 and file contents returned

josh_eng: quick workaround for the customer: send tool_args as a real JSON object, not a JSON string. Example: 
```json
POST /v1/toolcall
{
  "tool": "filesystem.read",
  "tool_args": { "path": "C:\Users\ACME\projects\test.txt" }
}
```

ryan_sre: alternative temporary workaround: base64 encode the inner payload and decode server-side, but that adds complexity. Better to patch client docs and improve error message detection.

erin_support: customer tried the object body suggestion and confirmed it fixed the 400, they can read the file now :thumbsup:

josh_eng: I'm opening an internal issue to make our parser error more actionable (detect double-stringified payloads and trailing commas, call out that tool_args should be an object).

issue-bot: Created issue #RINF-2042: improve tool_args validation + friendlier error messages

josh_eng: assigning to @josh_eng, tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for parser heuristics

erin_support: closing customer case, will follow up with the issue link and suggested client snippet.
